results.title: Does Minecraft have parental controls? | Proton
results.content:
Microsoft’s privacy policy(nové okno) states that it and Mojang collect account information, including your email address, gamer tag, avatars, age range, and the information associated with your gamer tag. The company may also collect usage data, like when you sign in and out of Xbox, when you make purchases, the games you play, the apps you use, your game progress, play time per game, in-game activity, rankings, gamer profiles, and other gaming statistics. [...] You can configure your child’s privacy settings within Minecraft to limit data sharing and manage their safety and communication preferences. If you download Minecraft on a smartphone, you will be prompted to allow Minecraft to track your activity across other companies’ apps and websites. Always select Ask App Not To Track.

## Help your child avoid distressing content [...] Encourage regular conversations about online experiences and concerns, like harassment, hate speech, or inappropriate content they might see in online communities or in gameplay.

### Set boundaries

Establish clear rules for online interactions and time allowed for playing Minecraft or other video games. Watch for problematic behaviors and gaming habits, like not finishing homework, foregoing sleep to play Minecraft, or not socializing with friends.

### Use strong passwords
